notes: Desktop Staff Reports Dashboard lazy-loading chart hotfix.
Fixes the Unable to load selected report: 5 >= 1 popup seen when opening report tabs after the 1.0.108 load-time update.
Prevents dashboard charts from reading unloaded one-column placeholder tables while reports are still loading on demand.
Allows Requested vs Received, Journey Summary, Intake Timing, Follow-Up Reason, Executive Breakdowns, and Data Completion reports to load independently.
Keeps Refresh fast by loading only the summary first, then loading drill-down report tables only when selected or when Load All Reports is clicked.
Keeps raw drill-down tables available while preserving the executive summary and breakdown-focused reports.
Keeps Java 25 bytecode compatibility so Staff secure local services start correctly on staff computers.
